claim_scope.outer: one fixed [240,120] linear constituent of minimum distance at least 25, repeated in every row

constituent_selection.justification: Restriction to any K-coordinate information set is a bijection. After the independent row-coordinate permutation, each retained weight-w support is uniform among B coordinates.

bound.monotonicity: Deleting input ones can only increase the tilted output moment.
bound.deletion: After the uniform row-coordinate permutation, retain a uniform minimum_weight-subset of each nonzero constituent support.
bound.bernoulli_envelope: A uniform minimum_weight-subset equals iid Bernoulli-p region incidences conditioned on exact weight minimum_weight. Dropping that conditioning costs the reciprocal binomial mass per row.
bound.region_transfer: The coefficient recurrence exactly averages the Q candidate positions over the uniform region permutation.
bound.global_zero_exclusion: A three-state region recurrence omits the globally all-zero reference input without alternating subtraction. Reference tuples with some, but not all, zero rows remain included.

limitations: The calculation uses nearest binary64 log arithmetic.
